comparison.interpretation: Only original qualified same-VM/source/four-ELF8192x2. Negative wall/CPU changes indicate reduction; negative rate changes indicate regression. Per-final wall normalizes equal business coverage; wall totals and nested child phases overlap, never add. Sampled peaks are not hard upper bounds. No sustained1000TPS/600s qualification.

businessNodeCommitAndResources.interpretation: Business heights only;4node execution samples are not4x business TPS. Per-role peaks occur at different times and must not be added; aggregate peak decomposition uses one actual sample. Stage children/quantiles are nested and not additive; batch density differs.

nodeCompletionJoins.interpretation: Original endpoint node transaction-height Finalize and durable Commit returns joined by block hash; durable readback and published Info each match their own post-state height/hash. Calibrated wall-clock envelopes include client/node drift. These are completion observations after reported verified BFT proof, not the earliest quorum formation instant. Original native admission and cryptographic verifier remain mandatory.
